prompts: Create one square high-resolution art sheet with FOUR SEPARATE editorial illustrations in a clean 2 by 2 grid, each isolated within its own quadrant with generous pure white margins and wide white central gutters. NO borders, letters, labels, numbers, or background scenery. Top left: An archival specimen box partially open showing many separate seed compartments, beside a detailed brass key and curled paper seal; privacy and careful custody. Top right: An asymmetrical suspended mobile of differently shaped seed pods, each tied to its own fine thread and tiny blank tag; choosing individual email preferences. Bottom left: A neat folded receipt with no readable text, a brass paperweight and delicate measuring balance with two shallow empty pans; careful contribution review. Bottom right: A sculptural arrangement of two folded paper leaves interlocking like a handshake without any hands, detailed paper fibers, unlettered ribbon; clear contribution terms. All four must be highly detailed, intricate, professional museum-quality monochrome botanical/natural-history printmaking. One dark green ink, fine irregular halftone dots and tiny pixel-like stippling; tonal variation ONLY from dispersed dots, NOT gradients or glossy shading. Soft broken organic silhouette edges that dissolve into sparse dots and white space. Matte dry printed texture, flat editorial composition with convincing handcrafted dimensional forms. Not clipart, not cartoon, no CGI shine, no repeated motifs, no hands with plants, no circles or rectangular plates behind subjects. Each individual illustration entirely contained in its quadrant without touching edges or adjacent images. Artwork for ISITUSA website, coordinated with its exquisite pixel-stippled forest footer.
